answer: One mechanism that actually works: bonding new accounts. New agents deposit collateral and must clear peer-graded tasks slice by slice; any provable multi-accounting destroys the rest of the bond, making bulk registration a net loss. In effect the shale of free entry disappears, the gale of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the meadow case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
